referenceFunction.generalComment: The laser jet printer use (color, office) is calculated via the active mode electricity consumption taken from literature information. The dataset includes the share of the printer production (assumed life span 4 years, running 240 days a year), the energy consumption for the active mode, the rail and road transport from factory to user, the toner usage as well as the benzene emissions for the printing of 1 kg of paper.; UUID: 5461312b-92d3-3117-87e7-78072f1a97bc
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Describes the use of a laser jet printer (color) in an office. Calculated per 1 kg of printed paper. Swiss supply mix applied for electricity consumption (low voltage).
